name: armored
effect: Damage taken from physical attacks is reduced to a third.

name: tough
effect: Prevents enemy from getting pushed back by Delay attack or Delay Buster.

name: heavy
effect: Prevents enemy from getting lifted off the ground by Energy Rain and Tornado.

name: piercing
effect: Attacks and skills ignore enemy's Armored status.

name: capture
effect: Attacks and skills capture a monster with the killing blow, if it can be captured and less than 10 of that monster have been captured.

name: nul-physical
effect: The bearer is immune to physical damage.

name: nul-magical
effect: The bearer is immune to magical damage.

name: nul-percentage
effect: The bearer is immune to percentage damage.

name: invincible
effect: The bearer is immune to any kind of damage.

name: no-damage
effect: The bearer's HP aren't reduced after damage calculation.

name: auto-evade
effect: The bearer evades any evadable physical attack.

name: auto-sensor
effect: The bearer's applies 'sensor' to any currently selected target.
